No. KNR-XI-85 (Estt.)/2026-
OFFICE OF THE DEPUTY COMMISSIONER,
DISTRICT KINNAUR AT RECKONG PEO, H.P.
***
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited from retired desirous and eligible candidates for re-engagement on
vacant posts of Naib-Tehsildars in District Kinnaur on remuneration basis. The application form alongwith all the
relevant supporting documents/ certificates should reach the office of Deputy Commissioner, Kinnaur at Reckong
Peo, H.P. on or before 23-11-2026. The applications received after the last date or found incomplete will be
rejected and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
Name of the Post Naib-Tehsildar
Number of Posts for re-
engagement
1. Naib-Tehsildar 03 post ( i.e Hangrang at Yangthang,
Moorang and Sangla).
Essential qualifications for re-
engagement.
1. Must have rendered minimum 5 years service in any wing
of revenue Department of HP before their superannuation
and having no departmental/ disciplinary proceeding
pending against them. A certificate in this behalf be
obtained by the retiree concerned from his/ her parent
department and submitted alongwith the application form.
2. The applicants will submit the medical fitness certificate
from a government hospital with the application form.
Age The retirees to be engaged should not be more than 65 Years of age
as on 30-11-2026.
Emoluments Rs. 60,000/- per month .
Place of posting Against any vacant post in field offices in District Kinnaur except
in the Home Tehsil/ Sub-Tehsil.
Re-engagement of retirees will be made on following Terms & Conditions:-
1. The retired Naib-Tehsildar will be re-engaged for 03 months in the first instance. It may be
extended further depending upon the performance of the candidate or the requirement.
2. They must have rendered minimum 5 years of service in any wing of Revenue Department of
H.P. before their superannuation and having no departmental/ disciplinary proceedings pending
against them.
3. They will be considered for respective post on the recommendation of the committee.
4. The retirees to be engaged should not be more than 65 years of age on the date of advertisement
of vacancies.
5. If the applications exceed the number of vacancies advertised by concerned appointing
authority, the candidate who are junior in age will be given preference for engagement against
such post.
6. The period of engagement will not be counted for any benefits whatsoever in the service
rendered by them before their superannuation.
7. The service of such retired persons will be purely on temporary basis and is liable to the
terminated by the respective appointing authority at any time during the period of such re-
engagement.
8. The persons to be engaged will be entitled for one day’s casual leave after putting one month of
service. No leave of any other kind will be admissible to him/her.
9. Unauthorized absence from the duty without the approval of the controlling officer shall
automatically lead to the termination of such engagement. They will not be entitled for
emoluments for the period of absence from duty.
10. The applicants will have to procure certificate of his/her fitness from a Government Hospital.
11. They will be entitled to TA/DA if required to go on tour in connection with his/her official
duties at the same rate as applicable to regular counterpart officials at the minimum of pay scale.
12. He/She shall continue to avail medical facilities and re-imbursement of Medical Expenses as
admissible to him/her as a retiree.
13. The monthly remuneration shall be paid to the re-engaged retirees on the basis of performance/
work conduct certificate, which shall also include the details of cases dealt/ disposed of by
him/her. This certificate shall be issued by the concerned Controlling Authority to the re-
engaged retiree at the end of month.
14. After clearance of pendency of revenue cases, the services of retired persons shall be terminated
by the concerned appointing authority.
15. The promotion of existing Officers/ Officials shall not be affected on account of re-engagement
of above retirees & the posts occupied by them will be considered vacant for the purpose of
promotion.
16. Their re-engagement is liable to be terminated on availability of regular officials.
Sd/-
( Sonakshi Singh Tomar, IAS)
Deputy Commissioner,
District Kinnaur at R-Peo, H.P.
Endst. No. As above- 1110114 Dated; 05-11-2026
Copy forwarded to the following for information and necessary action to;-
1. The Additional Chief Secretary-cum-F.C.(Revenue) to the Govt. of H.P. Shimla-2.
2. The Divisional Commissioner, Shimla Division, Shimla-2.
3. The Director, Land Records, Himachal Pradesh, Shimla.
4. The Additional District Magistrate, Pooh, District Kinnaur, H.P.
5. The Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil), Kalpa at R-Peo, District Kinnaur, H.P.
6. The Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil), Nichar at Bhabanagar, District Kinnaur, H.P.
7. The District Revenue Officer, Kinnaur at Reckong Peo.
8. All the Tehsildars/ Naib-Tehsildars in District Kinnaur, H.P.
9. The District Informatics Officer, NIC, Kinnaur at Reckong Peo with the request to upload the
advertisement alongwith the application form on the official website of this office.
10. The District Public Relation Officer, Kinnaur at R-Peo for wide publicity through print & electronic
media.
11. Notice Board of Deputy Commissioner Office, Kinnaur at R-Peo.
12. Guard File.
Sd/-
Deputy Commissioner,
District Kinnaur at R-Peo, H.P.
